common.authority: Documentary transcription of CP3_PERFORMANCE_CONVENTIONS.md performance/1.12, especially §14; no numeric convention changes. Registry was owed before HG3.
common.notation: R reporting currency; D calendar date; B,E period endpoints; X(c->R,d) exact admitted historical FX; q units; P raw listing close; V complete portfolio value; I_cash/I_kind external inflows; O external outflows; beta return base. Full definitions in the cited performance ruling.
common.historical_version_note: Existing historic manifests and values are not rewritten. market-data/1.16 is the market-data label the code runs once its label move is made (market-data/1.16 section 11 item 35); performance-registry/1.1 cited market-data/1.15 (PD-0067 decision 6), performance-registry/1.0 cited market-data/1.14, and performance/1.12's original §14 cited market-data/1.11.
common.fx: Native facts retain currency; reporting values use exact historical currency cross. Current mode chooses D_c(t), restricts market files to M_t; identity and source registries pinned at computation time. No current FX substituted for historical acquisition/event FX.
common.corporate_actions: Raw close times ledger units; confirmed ledger splits preserve value, unresolved or unapplied splits suppress affected quantities/basis; recorded dividend accrual ex-date and payment settlement per §§1,3,8.
common.state_rule: performance §1.5: worst applicable cause, reason selected only from own-severity causes; never present any result number when INSUFFICIENT_DATA. Preserve causes and freshness.
common.presentation: Exact rational arithmetic; derived money quantum from minor-units/1.1; ratios 1e-12; ROUND_HALF_UP; native recorded facts exact/padded per §2.2; decomposition uses §2.4.

states.valuation: AVAILABLE if inputs complete; LIMITED for limited market inputs; INSUFFICIENT_DATA for unavailable required quantity/price/FX, split suppression or unreconstructable ledger. Missing cost basis alone is not a valuation refusal.
states.partial: Per §1.4a: subtotal over all valued positions/cash/receivables only when complete total suppressed by unvalued components and set is known, with excluded count/list. Included-state worst; no valued component => unavailable NO_VALUED_COMPONENT. Before any snapshot: not emitted. Never used as return/weight denominator.
states.window: Window before inception/snapshot refused; required endpoint/flow failures propagate; known zero gain valid even without a positive return base.
states.return: Window and required segment inputs propagate; nonpositive base with gain, negative return factor and unavailable history refused per §5.3/§5.5; zero-capital empty segments factor 1 with disclosed ZERO_CAPITAL_PERIOD.
states.annual: Underlying return state; Y<1 => INSUFFICIENT_DATA, PERIOD_SHORTER_THAN_ONE_YEAR; total loss => INSUFFICIENT_DATA, TOTAL_LOSS. No annualization fallback.
states.mwr: Input failures; NO_CAPITAL; IRR_NOT_DEFINED; IRR_OUT_OF_RANGE; IRR_UNIQUENESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED => unavailable; limited inputs propagate; uniqueness required.
states.amount: A line with no recorded event is AVAILABLE zero; missing required event-date FX suppresses only its line; other states propagate.
states.gain: MISSING_COST_BASIS/UNKNOWN_BASIS, acquisition date/FX unavailable, split suppression, mixed native currencies and replay failures per §§3.8-3.9. Full unsupported position/sale value suppressed.
states.gain_total: §3.10 explicit allowed exclusions produce LIMITED only with measurable gross exclusion weight. Unknown sales/quantities or unpriced denominator => unavailable; all contributors excluded => unavailable; no sales => AVAILABLE zero.
states.basis: Unknown lot, unavailable acquisition FX, flagged replay or split suppression => unavailable; limited FX => LIMITED; no partial basis represented as full.
states.since: Basis/valuation/acquisition FX state; ENTRY in reporting currency has FX=1; recorded acquired_on used; absent foreign acquisition date => unavailable, never today FX.
states.attribution_money: All required daily inputs propagate. Missing return base or total-loss logarithm alone does not suppress money lines; exact sum remains G.
states.attribution_return: Money-input state plus NON_POSITIVE_BASE, NEGATIVE_VALUE or TOTAL_LOSS refusal for percentage lines; no logarithm at total loss.
